raw.thesis: narma is developing an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to automate workflows at scale. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: an "Observe" layer with lightweight sensors to capture work patterns, an "Intelligence Layer" that acts as a "Brain" to detect employee intent and business value, and an "Execution Layer" or "Agent Factory" that generates and deploys AI agents. This system focuses on integrating existing foundation models with a "Work Graph" to identify inefficiencies and automate tasks mid-flow, rather than building proprietary LLMs. This approach aims to provide "Continuous AI lift" by observing work, deciding AI actions, and continuously building agents. narma seeks to address the challenges AI-first companies face with limited telemetry for AI savings, unreliable ROI measurement, and constant drift in systems and human resources. The founder has not specified a particular goal for the venture (lifestyle, growth, or moonshot) or its current stage. The venture aims to replace existing solutions by providing a holistic, automated approach to AI deployment and optimization, contrasting with piecemeal solutions or manual analysis of work patterns.
raw.product_description: narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale. The architecture has three layers. Observe (Layer 1): lightweight desktop sensors capture work patterns including application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Intelligence Layer (Layer 2): a "Brain" that detects employee intent, the business value of tasks, and "drift" where work diverges from the intended flow. Execution Layer (Layer 3): an "Agent Factory" that automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities with built-in approval gates. The system uses existing foundation models rather than building its own LLMs, focusing instead on the "Work Graph" to reveal where resources are burned and where AI can intercept work mid-flow to provide assistance. Vision: a single system that observes how work happens, decides what AI should do next, and auto-builds agents continuously to ensure a "Continuous AI lift."
